sources.publisher: Canadian Centre for Occupational Health and Safety
sources.title: Safeguarding - General
sources.scope: General machine safeguarding, hierarchy of controls, guards, interlocks, and protective devices.
sources.notes: Guidance; not a substitute for applicable law, manufacturer instructions, or qualified design review.

sources.publisher: Canadian Centre for Occupational Health and Safety
sources.title: Safeguarding - Working around Machinery
sources.scope: Machine hazard identification, task review, risk estimation, and need for specialized technical expertise.
sources.notes: Use for evidence questions; do not infer a machine-specific safe state.

sources.publisher: Canadian Centre for Occupational Health and Safety
sources.title: Lockout/Tag out
sources.scope: Program-level hazardous energy control, roles, procedures, training, and audit concepts.
sources.notes: Does not authorize an equipment-specific procedure or restart.

sources.publisher: Canadian Centre for Occupational Health and Safety
sources.title: Hazardous Energy Control Programs
sources.scope: Hazardous energy types, stored energy, and control-program concepts.
sources.notes: CSA references are metadata only; protected standard text is not reproduced.

sources.publisher: Canadian Centre for Occupational Health and Safety
sources.title: Electrical Safety - Basic Information
sources.scope: Electrical jurisdiction split, qualified-person boundary, equipment certification, and basic controls.
sources.notes: Electrical requirements vary by jurisdiction; no live-work instruction is derived.

sources.publisher: Canadian Centre for Occupational Health and Safety
sources.title: Arc Flash
sources.scope: Arc-flash hazard recognition and control concepts.
sources.notes: PPE and approach decisions require task-specific qualified assessment.

sources.publisher: Canadian Centre for Occupational Health and Safety
sources.title: Robots and Cobots
sources.scope: Robot/cobot safeguarding, modes, inspections, testing, and lockout concepts.
sources.notes: Do not treat guidance as cell validation or permission to alter safety functions.

sources.publisher: Canadian Centre for Occupational Health and Safety
sources.title: Confined Space - Introduction
sources.scope: Confined-space hazard, isolation, atmosphere, hot-work, and program concepts across Canadian jurisdictions.
sources.notes: All jurisdictions have confined-space rules; exact requirements remain jurisdiction and site dependent.

sources.publisher: Canadian Centre for Occupational Health and Safety
sources.title: Welding - Hot Work
sources.scope: Hot-work management, permits, fire protection, combustible controls, and fire-watch concepts.
sources.notes: Permit issuance and local fire-code decisions remain with the responsible authority.

sources.publisher: Canadian Centre for Occupational Health and Safety
sources.title: Hazard and Risk - Hazard Identification
sources.scope: Hazard identification across chemical, physical, safety, equipment, and lifecycle changes.
sources.notes: Use to structure evidence collection, not to approve exposure controls.

sources.title: Workplace Hazardous Materials Information System (WHMIS)
sources.scope: WHMIS roles, supplier hazard communication, federal program responsibilities, and federal/provincial/territorial coordination.
sources.notes: Supplier and workplace responsibilities must remain separated by jurisdiction and role.

sources.title: Am I Regulated? Boilers and Pressure Vessels
sources.scope: Ontario pressure-equipment lifecycle, registration, inspection, engineering review, and certification boundaries.
sources.notes: Ontario-specific; do not generalize to another jurisdiction.

sources.title: Boilers and pressure vessels codes
sources.scope: Alberta pressure-equipment codes, permits, and delegated administration context.
sources.notes: Use the current applicable code and authority for the site and activity.

sources.title: Safety codes
sources.scope: Alberta safety-code disciplines including building, fire, electrical, and pressure equipment; delegated administration and enforcement context.
sources.notes: Use the current applicable code and authority for the site and activity.
